question: Does the Valkey health check expose the Valkey password in process arguments or environments inside the container?
method: Inside the running Valkey container, each form ran four times while a sampler read every process's command line and environment (one cat per sample) and counted samples containing the password, matched from a pattern file on the container's tmpfs. The measured commands keep each form's argument shape but keep valkey-cli alive about one second so it can be observed. Counts only; the password was never printed or recorded.
limitations: Processes running as another user (valkey-server) could not have their environment read without CAP_SYS_PTRACE; the health processes run as the exec user and were readable. The password still passes through a pipe and the shell's memory during the check.
